blocks.text: ISTANBUL, Turkey—Turkish rescuers on Friday recovered the bodies of three miners trapped in a mine collapse in western Turkey, raising the death toll to five, local authorities said. In a separate accident, another miner died on Friday during the collapse of an unlicensed mine in Kilimli, a town on Turkey‘s northwestern Black Sea coast, media reports said.
